rules: Icons are cartoon sticker-style: bold shapes, thick dark outline, one highlight, 256 px, transparent background.
Panels, cards and buttons are built from native rounded corners, strokes and gradients, so they stay crisp at every screen size.
Layout, proportions and colour roles follow the reference measurements; only the skin is cartoon.
Nothing touches: 8 px minimum between siblings at 1920x1080. Centred means measured. No frame draws a box round a single child.
Every dynamic label ships bound to live data; a label still showing its mockup text in play is a defect.
Every panel works with mouse, gamepad focus and touch.
note: roblox-ui spec. One tree emits the mockup, the .model.json and the Luau. Each screen above becomes one roblox-ui spec file in the UI stage.
